releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OGEngine.Client v2.0.2

Native AOT .NET client for the WEB4 OASIS API and WEB5 STAR API, plus P/Invoke interop exports for OGEngine-based games (OQuake, ODOOM etc). Handles avatar auth, inventory, quests, XP, karma, NFT minting and sync callbacks — bridging the OASIS/STAR platform directly into native game engines.
